title: Apply for admission
subtitle: It takes about 10 minutes. Keep the birth certificate and a recent photo ready.

student.medicalHint: Anything the school should know to keep your child safe.

review.title: Check your details
review.consent: I confirm the information is correct and agree that the school may store it to process this application.

success.title: Application received
success.body: Your reference number is {refNo}. We've emailed it to {email}. The school office will contact you to arrange an interview.

steps.one: The office reviews your application within a week.
steps.two: You receive your interview date by email and SMS.
steps.three: If offered a place, you're told your enrolment date, then get a parent-portal invitation when your child is enrolled.

validation.dob: Enter a valid date of birth

status.title: Check application status
status.subtitle: Enter your reference number and the email or mobile number on the application.
status.contactRequired: Enter the email or phone number on the application
status.notFound: We couldn't find an application with those details. Check the reference number, and the email or phone number.

next.new: The school office is reviewing your application. You'll be contacted within a week.
next.interview: Please attend the interview and placement test with your child at the time shown.
next.accepted: Congratulations! Please come to the school with your child on the enrolment date, ready to pay the enrolment fees.
next.rejected: Unfortunately we cannot offer a place this time. Please contact the office for details.
next.enrolled: Your child is enrolled. If you gave an email address, check it for the parent portal invitation.
